notes.title: Editor Updates and Cloud Saves
notes.content:
Hello All,

I deployed several app updates through the night (thanks to [b]copious[/b] amounts of energy drinks) and from my testing it appears many of the community concerns have been addressed.

[list]
[*] All three Editor applications were cleaned/rebuilt from source code.
[*] The main depo that houses all the files was wiped and reloaded with all fresh files and folder structures.
[*] The launcher received a handful of small updates to allow my update for the auto path discovering code and Steam integrations.
[*] The uninstaller received some updates and should fully remove all files for clean installs.
[/list]
 
[b]Cloud Autosaves are now fully setup and tested to be working![/b]

The biggest advantage to that, if you uninstall or have a system crash, any custom maps, scenario, or army files you created will now install as well!

Thanks again for your patience while we iron out the kinks and expect some good feature upgrades soon!
